limits: New synthetic rectilinear service-order problem, no empirical agricultural or kinematic validation.
Exact only among x-first/y-first shortest L paths; no arbitrary path, obstacles, curvature or collisions.
750 observations are repeated within30 geometries, not750 independent problems.
Lambda0.5 difference vanishes after best distance-optimal tie resolution; cannot claim genuine distance-turn tradeoff there.
Posthoc tie correction is diagnostic and not preregistered primary evidence.
